review_scope: Fresh no-context branch review of shipped guidance, tooling, packaging and maintained documentation; author outcomes excluded.

findings.issue: Default temporary directory may inherit a parent Git repository.
findings.correction: Initialize an isolated temporary repository; exclude its .git directory from the sealed output.
findings.regression: Real Git added/deleted-file reconstruction under an in-repository tempfile.tempdir failed with patch reconstruction mismatch before the fix and passed afterward.

findings.issue: Absent and invalid resolver service configs were conflated.
findings.correction: Distinguish absent fallback, invalid initial failure and retained previous policy; verify selected implementation.

provenance: Original campaign snapshots and receipts are unchanged. Main and HTTP guidance remain byte-identical to evaluated v2. The gRPC clarification is a post-review factual correction checked independently; no new author comparison or effectiveness gain is claimed.
limits: Grades apply to reviewed head before fixes; no grade re-review performed. Characterization uses pinned grpc-go v1.67.3 and local bufconn on Go 1.22.12 (external linker) and Go 1.26.5 (race). No production networking, automatic routing or new comparative author evaluation.
